title: 第15章 离开玄武秘境第16章 玄水重剑
content_zh:
杨修听到白蛇的话稳定心神，用心感受着龙血剑的气息，他的灵宝自然浮现出来在他的身前而立如同骑士一般守护在杨修身边，黄金鳄鱼可不管杨修顿不顿悟还在攻击着可是刚才凶猛且威力强大的攻击却被杨修的灵宝轻易化解，这一下更激怒了黄金鳄鱼，攻击也变的更加凶猛。
杨修闭目一会儿后一道光芒在他眼前浮现，他缓缓向这道光走去，当走到近前的时候光芒变成了画面，杨修生出食指触碰了画面一下，画面直接化作光芒没入他的身体，而闭目的杨修仿佛睁开了眼睛似的可以看清周围的环境，奋力进攻的黄金鳄鱼，应对着黄金鳄鱼攻击的剑胚灵宝还有闭着双眼的他。
“这是龙血剑的视角？”杨修喃喃道。
“没错！主人这是我的视角！”突然一个声音在杨修脑海里出现吓了杨修一跳。
“你是谁？”杨修开口问道。
“主人我是龙血剑的初意识！”声音再次说话回答杨修的问题。
这个回答让杨修更加摸不着头脑了，但龙血剑初意识似乎看出了杨修的疑惑，没等杨修开口问便直接说道“初意识就是剑灵的雏形，而我现在距离剑灵凝聚还差一个条件！”
“什么条件？”杨修问。
“请主人为我赐一个名字！因为我是并非由生灵所化之剑只是单纯吸收了妖龙精血罢了，初意识也是在主人的灵宝帮我铸造剑身时产生的，所以先是我只差一个名字便可以凝聚剑灵！”杨修脑海中龙血剑的声音带着兴奋以及迫不及待。
龙血剑的回答很清晰让杨修一听就懂了几乎没有犹豫杨修就开口道“今天开始你就叫赤！”
当杨修话落之后意识空间再次波动，这次杨修周围全部亮起来了，随后再杨修身前的空间一个光团渐渐浮现凝实一只红色小龙出现。
“你凝聚的剑灵不是人身？”杨修伸出手抚摸一下小龙问道。
赤边感受杨修抚摸边开口回答“主人我刚凝聚还没有办法凝聚人身只能变成现在这样！”
杨修点点头再次抚摸了一下赤的脑袋开口“助我将那只黄金鳄鱼击败吧！”
赤点点头随后没入杨修的右手，只见杨修右手手背一道金纹浮现，然后他可以感觉到自己已经完全掌控龙血剑，并不是单纯用灵气御使龙血剑。
“铮”杨修完全掌控龙血剑之后一声剑鸣从黄金鳄鱼身后响起，下一秒便向黄金我鳄鱼杀去。
原本还在攻击杨修的黄金鳄鱼感觉不妙一个闪身躲过了这一剑，杨修也睁开了眼睛，而刚刚还在为杨修抵挡攻击的灵宝重新没入杨修意识空间里。
杨修右手一动龙血剑再次杀向黄金鳄鱼这次不仅仅是单纯的剑身攻击，而是每一击都带着一股灵气波动，而龙血剑剑身红色纹路变的如血液一般在剑身内流动。
杨修施展踏云步来到黄金鳄鱼身前将灵气凝聚到右手施展让黄金鳄鱼受伤的那一拳，只是这次并未将灵宝唤出，但是这一拳带给黄金鳄鱼的压力丝毫不比之前击伤黄金鳄鱼那一拳差，与其说是一拳袭来不如说是一剑刺来。
黄金鳄鱼想都没想直接放弃抵抗龙血剑转而攻击杨修，谁知杨修微微一笑，收起右拳施展踏云步又开始后退而龙血剑剑身一道剑气斩出击中黄金鳄鱼的侧身，痛的黄金鳄鱼嘶吼一声。

白蛇看到杨修的攻击吐了吐蛇信点点头说道“自己佯攻实则御剑斩出剑气击伤黄金鳄鱼，聪明的小子！”
“哼”巨龟不满的哼了一声开口道“以剑灵操控剑施展剑气，投机取巧的神品御剑术罢了！并不是真正的神品御剑术。”
“嘶嘶嘶，哈哈哈哈，他现在能悟到这种程度已经不容易了！”白蛇先是一笑后又开口“以身为剑，这小子剑道已经到达人剑合一了嘛，这个年纪天赋还是蛮强的。”
巨龟思索了一下开口“这小子给我一种怪异感！”
这话让白蛇疑惑了开口道“什么怪异感？”
“就是我承认这小子剑道天赋很强，这个年纪人剑合一极少有人做到，但是我觉得他可能会的更多，但是好像自己还不知道没有发觉出来，就像是练了很久的功法长时间不用遗忘了，等再次施展出来脑海中不记得但是身体以及意识证明着自己曾经会这部功法的感觉！很别扭！”巨龟开口解释。
“感觉他的剑道天赋确实已经达到了剑道通神的地步，属于只要点拨两句就能掌握的地步，你说他不会是楚浩然转世吧！”白蛇看着不远处还在战斗的杨修说道。
“不可能，先不说楚浩然有没有转世的可能，单凭的气息就没有楚浩然那种感觉，作为先天成神楚浩然那种冷漠感是从骨头里透露出来的，这小子没有那种感觉！”巨龟否定了白蛇的话，白蛇闻言也没有再次开口。
“不能再拖下去了，赶紧搞定这只黄金鳄鱼吧！”杨修说道，他身边无人这话是说给赤听的，右手金纹闪烁一下，证明了解。
“铮”龙血剑剑身气势再次攀登一步，一股灼热的气息从剑身涌出，这是来自被龙血剑吸收了妖龙精血的妖龙龙威

“吼！”黄金鳄鱼感受到龙血剑散发的气息生物本能让它感觉到恐惧的嘶吼一声，龙血剑散发出的龙威有震慑它的效果，但是他体内神鳄血脉也很大程度削弱了这道龙威带来的压迫感。
“嗷”黄金鳄鱼没有冲向带着龙威的龙血剑而是选择了没有丝毫压迫感的杨修进行攻击，张开血盆大口便对杨修咬去。
杨修见状侧身躲过，意念操控龙血剑快速接近黄金鳄鱼准备使出拔剑斩，而他自身凝聚灵气于右脚之上准备攻击黄金鳄鱼。
谁知这时黄金鳄鱼左爪发力强行改变身形冒着腹部被龙血剑攻击的风险拼命向杨修咬去，它在赌自己的攻击比龙血剑的更快，只要一口咬死这个人类，那该死的剑肯定不攻自破。
黄金鳄鱼的果断让杨修大惊，杨修见状赶忙散去右脚上的灵气伸手从储物戒取出郑元雪送给自己那柄剑的剑鞘，这柄剑剑身还留在郑元雪那里，伸手将剑鞘立在黄金鳄鱼口中，待黄金鳄鱼咬下的一瞬间抽出手紧接着施展踏云步后退。
“吼”黄金鳄鱼的攻击失败了，龙血剑拔剑术的剑气斩在他的腹部，它受伤严重的侧翻在地嘴巴，刚刚那柄剑鞘虽然被它咬碎了但是还是给杨修拖延了时间的，它的攻击还是攻击到杨修，而拔剑术带来的伤势让它已经无力再战了。
杨修望着虚弱的躺在地上的黄金鳄鱼挥了挥手龙血剑飞到他的手中，杨修走到黄金鳄鱼身前双手持剑准备斩杀它黄金鳄鱼时脑袋恍惚，待他清醒时重新回到了剑山，脑海中还有一个声音回档“这只黄金鳄鱼是为数不多的神鳄血脉且留它一命，你的神品御剑术还并未完全领悟万万不可松懈修炼！这把重剑便作为你通过秘境和饶恕黄金鳄鱼的奖励吧！”

content_en:
Yang Xiu calmed down after hearing White Snake's words, and felt the breath of the Dragon Blood Sword with his heart. His spiritual treasure naturally appeared in front of him and stood guarding Yang Xiu like a knight. The golden crocodile continued to attack regardless of whether Yang Xiu had an epiphany or not. However, the fierce and powerful attack just now was easily resolved by Yang Xiu's spiritual treasure. This angered the golden crocodile even more, and the attack became more ferocious.
After Yang Xiu closed his eyes for a while, a ray of light appeared in front of his eyes. He slowly walked towards the light. When he came closer, the light turned into a picture. Yang Xiu touched the picture with his index finger, and the picture turned into light and sank into his body. With his eyes closed, Yang Xiu seemed to have opened his eyes and could see the surrounding environment clearly. The golden crocodile was attacking hard, the Sword Embryo Lingbao facing the attack of the golden crocodile, and him with his eyes closed.
"Is this the perspective of the Dragon Blood Sword?" Yang Xiu murmured.
"That's right! Master, this is my perspective!" Suddenly a voice appeared in Yang Xiu's mind, which startled Yang Xiu.
"Who are you?" Yang Xiu asked.
"Master, I am the first consciousness of Dragon Blood Sword!" The voice spoke again to answer Yang Xiu's question.
This answer made Yang Xiu even more confused, but Dragon Blood Sword's first consciousness seemed to see Yang Xiu's doubts. Before Yang Xiu could ask, he said directly, "The first consciousness is the prototype of the sword spirit, and I am still one condition away from the condensed sword spirit!"
"What conditions?" Yang Xiu asked.
"Master, please give me a name! Because I am not a sword transformed from a living being, but simply absorbed the essence and blood of the demon dragon. My first consciousness was also generated when the master's spiritual treasure helped me cast the sword body, so first I only have one name left to condense the sword spirit!" The voice of the Dragon Blood Sword in Yang Xiu's mind was filled with excitement and impatience.
Dragon Blood Sword's answer was so clear that Yang Xiu understood it immediately. Without any hesitation, Yang Xiu said, "From today on, your name will be Chi!"
After Yang Xiu finished speaking, the space of consciousness fluctuated again. This time, everything around Yang Xiu lit up, and then a ball of light gradually emerged and solidified in the space in front of Yang Xiu, and a small red dragon appeared.
"The sword spirit you condensed is not a human body?" Yang Xiu reached out and touched the little dragon and asked.
Chibian felt Yang Xiu's touch and answered, "Master, I just condensed and I haven't been able to condense my body yet, so I can only become like this!"
Yang Xiu nodded and stroked Chi's head again and said, "Help me defeat that golden crocodile!"
Chi nodded and then slipped into Yang Xiu's right hand. He saw a golden pattern appear on the back of Yang Xiu's right hand. Then he could feel that he had completely controlled the Dragon Blood Sword, and he was not just using the aura to control the Dragon Blood Sword.
"Zheng" After Yang Xiu took full control of the Dragon Blood Sword, a sword cry sounded from behind the golden crocodile, and the next second he killed the golden crocodile.
The golden crocodile that was still attacking Yang Xiu felt bad and dodged the sword. Yang Xiu also opened his eyes, and the Lingbao that had just been blocking the attack for Yang Xiu re-entered Yang Xiu's consciousness space.
Yang Xiu moved his right hand and used the dragon blood sword to kill the golden crocodile again. This time it was not just a simple sword attack, but every blow carried a wave of spiritual energy, and the red lines on the dragon blood sword became like blood flowing in the sword.
Yang Xiu used the Cloud Step to come to the golden crocodile, condensed his spiritual energy into his right hand, and used the punch that injured the golden crocodile. However, this time he did not call out the spirit treasure, but the pressure brought by this punch to the golden crocodile was no worse than the previous punch that injured the golden crocodile. It was not so much a punch as a sword thrust.
Without thinking, the golden crocodile gave up resisting the Dragon Blood Sword and attacked Yang Xiu. Unexpectedly, Yang Xiu smiled slightly, put away his right fist and performed Cloud Step and started to retreat. The Dragon Blood Sword slashed out with sword energy and hit the side of the golden crocodile. The golden crocodile roared in pain.
When White Snake saw Yang Xiu's attack, he spat out the snake letter and nodded, saying, "I pretended to attack but actually used my sword to slash out."He injured the golden crocodile with his energy, you smart boy! "
"Hmph," the giant turtle grunted in dissatisfaction and said, "It's just an opportunistic and divine sword-controlling technique that uses the sword spirit to control the sword and exert sword energy! It is not a true divine sword-controlling skill. "
“Hiss, hahahaha, it’s not easy for him to realize this level now! "White Snake smiled first and then said, "As a sword, this boy's swordsmanship has reached the point where the human sword can be integrated into one. His talent is quite strong at this age. "
The giant turtle thought for a moment and said, "This kid gives me a weird feeling! "
These words made White Snake confused and said, "What's the weird feeling? "
"I admit that this boy is very talented in swordsmanship. Very few people at this age can combine swordsmanship with each other, but I think he may be able to do more, but it seems that he doesn't know it yet and hasn't noticed it yet. It's like a skill that has been practiced for a long time and has not been forgotten for a long time. When it is used again, I can't remember it in my mind, but my body and consciousness prove that I have mastered this skill! Very awkward! "The giant turtle opened his mouth to explain.
"I feel that his talent in swordsmanship has indeed reached the level of swordsmanship, which can be mastered with just a few instructions. Do you think he is the reincarnation of Chu Haoran? "White Snake said while looking at Yang Xiu who was still fighting not far away.
"Impossible, let's not talk about whether Chu Haoran has the possibility of reincarnation. The aura alone does not have the feeling of Chu Haoran. As an innate god, Chu Haoran's indifference is revealed from his bones. This boy does not have that feeling! "The giant turtle denied what the white snake said, and the white snake did not speak again after hearing the words.
"We can't delay it any longer, let's get rid of this golden crocodile quickly! "Yang Xiu said. No one around him meant this to Chi. The golden pattern on his right hand flashed to prove his understanding.
"Zheng" The momentum of the Dragon Blood Sword climbed one step higher again, and a hot breath surged out from the sword. This came from the power of the demon dragon who had absorbed the essence blood of the demon dragon in the Dragon Blood Sword.

"Ho! "The golden crocodile felt the aura emitted by the dragon blood sword, and its biological instinct made it roar in fear. The dragon's power emitted by the dragon's blood sword had the effect of intimidating it, but the divine crocodile blood in his body also greatly weakened the sense of oppression brought by this dragon's power.
"Ouch" The golden crocodile did not rush towards the mighty Dragon Blood Sword but chose Yang Xiu to attack without any sense of oppression. He opened his bloody mouth and bit Yang Xiu.
Seeing this, Yang Xiu dodged sideways, and controlled the Dragon Blood Sword with his mind to quickly approach the golden crocodile, preparing to use the sword to slash, while he condensed his spiritual energy on his right foot and prepared to attack the golden crocodile.
Unexpectedly, at this time, the golden crocodile used its left claw to forcefully change its body shape and risked being attacked by the Dragon Blood Sword on its abdomen to bite Yang Xiu desperately. It was betting that its attack would be faster than that of the Dragon Blood Sword. As long as it killed this human with one bite, the damn sword would definitely be destroyed.
The decisiveness of the golden crocodile shocked Yang Xiu. When Yang Xiu saw this, he quickly dispersed the aura on his right foot and reached out from the storage ring to take out the scabbard of the sword Zheng Yuanxue gave him. The blade of the sword was still left with Zheng Yuanxue. He reached out and placed the scabbard in the mouth of the golden crocodile. When the golden crocodile bit it, he pulled out his hand and then used Cloud Step to retreat.
"Roar" The golden crocodile's attack failed. The sword energy of the Dragon Blood Sword Drawing Technique slashed into his abdomen. It was seriously injured and fell to the ground with its mouth. Although the scabbard was bitten to pieces by it, it still delayed Yang Xiu's time. Its attack still hit Yang Xiu, and the injuries caused by the Drawing Sword Technique made it unable to fight anymore.
Yang Xiu looked at the weak golden crocodile lying on the ground and waved the Dragon Blood Sword and flew into his hand. Yang Xiu walked up to the golden crocodile with swords in both hands and prepared to kill it. The golden crocodile's head was in a trance. When he regained consciousness, he returned to Sword Mountain. There was a voice in his mind that replied, "This golden crocodile is one of the few divine crocodile bloodlines. Please keep it alive. Your divine gift."You have not yet fully understood the art of sword control and must not relax in your practice! Let this heavy sword be your reward for passing the secret realm and sparing the golden crocodile! "
